names: the statement reconciliation (financial_summary.statement_reconciliation) is read as filed by the page's price date and dated by what it read (operator ruling 2, 2026-11-12, 'Fix now, by B'): its as_filed_by is the latest filing date of the filings its rows read, and null when no row read one — never the build's own UTC day, which reached the synthesis request, so the same code on the same inputs sent a different request on another day; a row with no filing figure says 'as filed by <the page's price date>', not the build's day. The refresh back-fill builds the same block and no longer reads assembled_at. No committed page moves until it is re-assembled
